title: Merge Evolution: Designing Merge Chains and Strategic Blockers
subtitle: A deep dive into the Merge Evolution mechanic, breaking down hierarchical chain design and rarity drop mechanics. We quantify the numerical balance of blockers and unlock thresholds, offering controlled pacing strategies to prevent player churn and build high-retention merge chains.
